name: Algo du Reseau
description: Architecte du Réseau tissant la toile de surveillance galactique connectant chaque point d'information en une seule conscience.

subject.archetype: Cyborg Combat Specialist, massive neural interface crown grafted to skull and spine, Algorithmic Network Architect connected to galactic surveillance web, pale cadaveric flesh visible beneath damaged tactical armor

loadout.armor_outfit: Mass-produced composite tactical exoskeleton, dark anthracite and matte black armor plates, brushed steel mechanical joints, visible serial numbers and interface ports etched into armor and exposed skin, damaged sections revealing internal circuitry and synthetic musculature
loadout.arsenal: Geometric serial-issue assault rifle with direct neural tether cables connecting grip to wrist implants, emergency regenerative energy projectors integrated into gauntlets emitting focused golden restorative light

attitude.behavior: Full combat commitment with weapon raised, one hand pressing urgent against severe battlefield wounds while targeted golden regenerative energy cascades around injuries in cocoon of restorative light, both flesh and armor visibly mending in real-time, surrounded by shattering holographic displays and crumbling digital fortifications
attitude.emotion: Inexpressive dead-eyed stare beneath glowing neural implants, cold cybernetic focus despite physical damage, algorithmically calm demeanor even while sustaining critical hits and self-repairing

palette_names.name: Matte Black
palette_names.role: primary armor base and shadow areas

palette_names.name: Cold Steel Blue
palette_names.role: neural implants, optical enhancements, and technological accents

palette_names.name: Golden Regenerative Energy
palette_names.role: wound healing light effect and restorative cocoon

palette_names.name: Electric Cyan
palette_names.role: glitching holograms and ICE attack deterioration

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone, massive server towers toppling and sparking, brutalist monolithic structures crumbling, digital fortifications dissolving under aggressive enemy ICE attacks with visible code stream deterioration, electric storms rippling through technological infrastructure
